audit.whatIsWrong: All seven level-chart rows disagreed between the two layers. phases[].side read Diana/Diana/Skill/Skill/Diana/Skill/Skill; win[] read Akali/Akali/Akali/Diana/Skill/Akali/Akali. The content chart also gave Akali 5 of 7 stages against a 50.22% win rate.
audit.why: 50.22% over 229 games is dead even, so the chart should balance out. Diana's real ownership window is levels 4-6: Pale Cascade falls to 10.5s and its third sphere doubles the shield, then Moonfall arrives on 100s against Akali's 120s. Akali owns 1-2 (Crescent Strike 8s vs Q 1.5s, and Lunar Rush costs a full 22s without Moonlight) and late (Moonfall is only 475 range, so a flank never enters the pull).
audit.corrected: Reconciled chart, both layers, matched pairs: Akali, Akali, Skill, Diana, Diana, Skill, Akali — 3 Akali, 2 Skill, 2 Diana.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was described as Diana's spike but the reason given ('lets her pull you into range') missed the part that matters against Akali, and the first-item spike was hand-waved as a coinflip with no mechanism.
audit.why: Moonfall REVEALS as well as draws in — it is the one tool in her kit that answers Twilight Shroud, and at 100/90/80 it cycles faster than Perfect Execution's 120/90/60. Pale Cascade's shield is the first-item mechanism: it decides whether Akali's one burst window kills.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text and spikes[2].text rewritten around Moonfall's reveal-plus-pull and Pale Cascade's shield, with the real ultimate cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three things. (a) Crescent Strike was repeatedly called a 'sphere' — the spheres are Pale Cascade (W); Crescent Strike is an arcing bolt. (b) The Moonlight rule was stated backwards-lite: the point is that Lunar Rush has NO cooldown against a Moonlight target and costs 22/20/18/16/14 otherwise, and that casting Lunar Rush at anything else strips Moonlight from everyone. (c) Moonfall's reveal — the single interaction that beats Twilight Shroud — was never mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: All three come straight from Riot's descriptions in the kit. Note that Crescent Strike's 'revealsStealth' derived flag is a parse misfire: Riot's text says it reveals enemies 'if they are not stealthed', so it does NOT pull Akali out of the shroud. Only Moonfall does.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, enemyWin, breakdown.feeding, wants.foe[0], spikes[0..2].text rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: No numbers. 'Read it like a second minimap' is not a cooldown window.
audit.why: The punishable cooldown is Lunar Rush at 22s rank 1, and it only exists when Crescent Strike misses. Crescent Strike itself is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6, Pale Cascade 15 down to 9, Moonfall 100/90/80.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, phases[0].why and phases[1].why.

edits.before: Moonlight marks reset her dash — sidestep the arc and her dive has no follow-up. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.

edits.before: Diana whiffs Crescent Strike and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Crescent Strike whiffed means Lunar Rush is on full cooldown — go.

edits.before: That is Diana’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.

edits.before: The shroud spent farming is the dive you can't answer — W is your Flash, your Zhonya's, and your opening all at once.
edits.after: You need the E re-cast as your exit — Pale Cascade's shield can eat a full commit and leave you standing in melee.

edits.before: Carry through deletions — one carry per fight, every fight; the shroud buys the time and the resets pay the exit.
edits.after: Diana is a shield, not a wall — burst through Pale Cascade in one window, then shroud the answer and E-reset out.

edits.before: If Diana takes first blood, tighten up: Crescent Strike is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with Q range and stay relevant through shroud picks.
edits.after: If Diana takes first blood, never stand within Moonfall's 475 range — the pull drags you straight out of the shroud. Farm at Q range, dodge every arc, and stay relevant through shroud picks.

edits.before: Diana wins by landing Crescent Strike, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Diana wins by marking you with Moonlight for a free Lunar Rush, shielding through your burst, and pulling you out of the smoke.

edits.before: Land Crescent Strike sphere for the guaranteed follow-up gap-close
edits.after: Land Crescent Strike so Lunar Rush costs her nothing to follow

edits.before: You out-trade Diana early because her Crescent Strike (Q) sphere requires a hit before she can safely engage, and your Shuriken Flip punishes her for whiffing it at close range.
edits.after: You out-trade Diana early because Lunar Rush only resets on a Moonlight-marked target — sidestep Crescent Strike and her 22-second dash is her entire engage plan.

edits.before: Diana's ultimate pull comes online and flips the all-in dynamic — she can now yank you into range and combo before your own Perfect Execution finishes its cooldown, making this her strongest single level of the lane.
edits.after: Moonfall comes online and flips the all-in: it reveals you and drags you out of Twilight Shroud, and at 100 seconds it is up far more often than your 120-second Perfect Execution. Her strongest level of the lane.

edits.before: This is genuine 50/50 skill-matchup territory once both sides hit core items: whoever lands their engage first (your E-flip vs her Q-sphere gap-close) usually wins the fight outright.
edits.after: Genuine 50/50 once both sides hit core items: your burst beats Pale Cascade's shield, her Moonfall beats your smoke, and whoever opens the fight usually finishes it outright.
